notes.title: Performance and Stability patch
notes.notes: Long overdue patches for performance and stability.  Also initial work towards a Linux version but still not working quite right on Steam.

notes.title: Major Update to Jormungandr
notes.notes:
A long awaited update to Jormungandr is now live and brings graphical improvements, fixes, and 20 more levels of ship destruction.  There has also been a ton of tweaks and improvements to the mechanics to make the game more challenging, and to improve playability.  Major bullet points are as follows:


Island coloring and textures have been significantly improved
The number of levels has been increased from 20 to 40
Jormungandr's head model has been improved
The follower camera mechanics have been improved so it's not so jarring
Multiple fixes to settings to improve reliability and usability
Movement and turning speed have been tweaked
Improved ship mechanics including the ability to reverse course upon collisions
You now take continuous damage if you run into yourself
Continuous damage is also used when you run into islands

notes.title: Preparing for our first patch
notes.notes:
Looking forward, we're putting together our first patch now.  At this time, we're looking to make some tweaks to the procedural generation and level management mechanics, as well as some improvements to the ship mechanics.  These initiatives should improve gameplay, as well as getting us ready for our first content update.


Also, time is running out to get Jormungandr for 20% off.  The discount only applies to the first week of release, so it'll end July 2nd.

notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes: While Jormungandr was originally targeted for release on 6/28 at $6.99 USD, we're going to take a little off the top.  Our new release date is 6/25, and the price has been dropped to $4.99 USD.  We think this is a fair price, since the game has been trimmed down to 20 levels with plans for a content patch if there’s enough interest.  Enjoy the lower price, and follow us here on Steam to grab a copy on the 25th!

notes.title: Release and Cloud Saves
notes.notes:
It's been a while, but there's been a ton of work done to button up Jormungandr for release, like a new title screen, and more importantly, support for Steam Cloud Saves, so your progress will be saved to the cloud.

While our original release date was 6/28, we're trying to target an earlier release in the coming week (give or take)  There's so much more to share, but we're just not ready yet.  Follow Jormungandr to stay in the loop.
